issue_context.title: Log sampled successful probe execution with higher verbosity
issue_context.body:
/sig node
/sig instrumentation
/kind feature
/priority backlog

It will be useful to log successful probes execution details with higher verbosity once in a while. With the default verbosity no information on successful probe execution is reported. Which is fine as it typically very verbose and rarely needed. However if somebody investigating a problem with probes and cannot make sense why they are not failing when expected to fail, logs would be very interesting.

One suggestion may be to log successful probe execution logs with higher verbosity once in 15 minutes or so. This will make sure that logs are not too verbose, while allowing troubleshooting without changing verbosity to higher level.
comments: The `trace `https://github.com/kubernetes/utils/tree/master/trace pakacge provides an interface for recording the latency of operations and logging details about all operations where the latency exceeds a limit. so we may realize a similar trace log which could log verbosity with a specific frequency

review_comments:
I wonder if this print is reasonable?
Is the information in `"%s-%s-%s", probeType, klog.KObj(pod), container.Name` repeated with the following?
This will print a trace on every log level except V=3. I don't think we want to print traces for any log level lower than V=5.

If log level is equals or higher than V=3, the original code would print Probe successful logs, so we don't need this trace at all,  however, if log level is lower than 3, we can also use the trace to print the logs not too verbose without changing the level, that is every 15 mimutes or longer, this is the intention for the issue which opened by @SergeyKanzhelev.

If this work has no value, we can stop.
